glm_upstream_series.note: SparkGLM's upstream GLM-5.3-Flash series, which the Qwen series stacks on: generic serving, scheduler, grammar, prefix-cache and RDMA pair-communication work. Its GLM-only paths are gated by model type or kernel target and stay off for qwen4_exp.

upstream_candidate.note: The Qwen3.8-Flash-Next series in PR order: Atlas-Inf's unmerged Flash-Next fixes, TP=EP=2 for qwen4_exp, MTP at TP2, piecewise decode graphs, exact decode, verify, batching and prefill kernels, and the opt-in FP8 GDN projections and TC2R QSA prefill (docs/ENGINE.md). Also: rank-agreed Marconi restore depth in every multi-rank world (a TP2 prefix-cache deadlock fix), agreed KV-exhaustion refusals in decode/verify instead of a dead pair, and the long-context memory work (one-layer drafter KV, on-demand QSA carry, sliding raw-key window) that takes the 262K x 4 KV pool from 106K to 307K tokens at util 0.88.
